UnitStatement: Phase C4 GUI slice makes the R3 exit criterion (PRD §22.4) GUI-true by adding a service route and panel over the existing run_rule_checks backend command without backend change.

Binding controls are derived from the loaded pack: a solved-result-row select per solver_result input, value+unit entry per user-supplied input and value slot, and a deferred note per private_library_value input.
Unbound or missing rule-check inputs block the check at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE; pass/fail is never reported on missing inputs.

Run results report the aggregate status and per-check outcomes (status, computed/limit quantity, acceptability relation, supplied/MISSING bound inputs, completeness and evaluator findings, diagnostic codes) plus the professional-boundary notice.
The rule-check runner runs in the Tauri runtime only; in browser preview running reports the honest RULE-CHECK-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY seam, so the browser e2e does not assert pass/fail.
